subject: Renewal kickoff: NovaCorp term adjustment, capacity request, and QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@cloudworks.ai>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@novacorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal kickoff: NovaCorp term adjustment, capacity request, and QBR scheduling

Hi Sanjay / Alyssa —

Thanks for taking the time last week to review usage and runway. As discussed, NovaCorp is coming up on the annual renewal window and there are three items we should align on as part of the kickoff:

1) Term & pricing: NovaCorp is evaluating a 12 vs 24 month term and potentially a tiered usage discount tied to committed throughput.
2) Capacity: you mentioned a steady 25% throughput increase for Q1 (embedding + chat), with a potential burst for holiday traffic. We should size burst capacity and any reserved pool.
3) QBR: schedule a renewal QBR with execs + infra to review SLA, migration windows, and sign-off.

Proposed next steps / timeline:
- This week: confirm decision stakeholders and procurement timeline (Alyssa — can you confirm PO cadence?).
- By Nov 18: target to finalize term length and commit level so we can prepare SOW and DocuSign.
- Week of Nov 29: Renewal QBR (30–45 mins) — I’ve suggested two slots below.

Proposed QBR slots (PST):
- Tue Dec 1, 10:00–10:45
- Thu Dec 3, 15:00–15:45

Please copy any procurement or legal contacts who need to be looped in. I’m attaching a draft SOW with an initial sizing and an agenda for the QBR.

Attachments: NovaCorp_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW draft), QBR_Agenda_NovaCorp.docx

Thanks — looking forward to getting this staged so the team has runway.

— Alex Martinez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@cloudworks.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@novacorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: NovaCorp term adjustment, capacity request, and QBR scheduling

Alex — thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. A few quick notes from my side: 

- We are interested in a 24-month term if the tiered pricing is workable; need to circulate to finance for numbers.
- Capacity: confirmed internal forecast shows a 20–30% uplift Jan–Mar with a targeted holiday spike on Dec 15–22. If we lock burst capacity that would be ideal.
- Procurement: Alyssa handles the PO and legal routing. My ask is to have SOW + a blank DocuSign by Nov 20 so we can start internal approval.

For the QBR slots, Dec 1 at 10:00 PST works for me. If that’s acceptable on your side, I’ll tentatively reserve that time for our execs.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Head of Platform | CloudWorks.ai
(sanjay@cloudworks.ai)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: NovaCorp term adjustment, capacity request, and QBR scheduling

Alex / team — internal planning notes and asks for the QBR prep: 

- Capacity sizing: I reviewed their reported token distribution. To support a 30% steady uplift + 2x holiday burst, recommended reserved pool configuration: 4x A100-equivalents reserved, with 8x burst headroom via shared spare capacity. If they commit to a 24-month term at the proposed tier, we can offer a 12% unit discount.
- Quantization: Monica — can you validate whether their LLM usage is friendly to our int8 profile? If yes, that helps reduce baseline cost.
- On-call coverage: Grace — please confirm if a dedicated kickoff runbook is needed for Dec 15–22 spike monitoring (we should include incident contacts in the QBR).

Action items before Nov 18:
- Monica: run quantization compatibility check and reply with any model red flags (target by Nov 16).
- Alex: send SOW + DocuSign ready copy to Alyssa by Nov 18.
- Grace: prepare monitoring runbook draft and incident contact list by Nov 22.

Thanks — I’ll be on the QBR if Sanjay confirms Dec 1.

— Karthik
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference

Great — Dec 1 at 10:00 PST is locked for the QBR.

Quick update on the action items: 
- Attached for your review: NovaCorp_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW now includes two term options and the 12% tiered discount for 24 months). I also uploaded a DocuSign template link below so procurement can start routing.
- Monica confirmed the models look compatible with our int8 path; small model-specific tuning required — she’ll have a short report in the runbook.
- Grace has started the monitoring runbook and will circulate the incident contact list by Monday Nov 22.
